text:
incident-bot: Paging: control-plane-errors — elevated 5xx rate detected for control-plane services. Pager duty: matt_oncall.

Jordan: seeing a steady spike in 502/503 from config-gateway and auth-proxy since ~09:12 UTC. Frontend errors for API and console.

Maria: load graphs show auth latency climbing then errors. org-lookup latencies also up. likely auth -> org-lookup cascade.

Sam_K: confirmable in logs: repetitive downstream timeouts: `GET /orgs/lookup` -> 504s from orgs-db-proxy.

Elaine: customer impact: some return 5xx for hosted API generation requests, intermittent for dedicated customers hitting control plane routes. CS saying 3 customers reported UI errors. @Customer Success - Amy can you triage customer severity?

Customer Success - Amy: confirmed two paying customers reported request failures and timeouts. Marking P2 for revenue impact until we know scope. Sending outbound note to accounts.

Jordan: quick mitigation checklist: 1) route config reads to cached replica 2) enable auth degraded-mode (skip org enrichment) 3) rate-limit noisy clients 4) fallback to previous auth-v1.

Sam_K: can we flip auth to v1 fallback? auth-team documented a toggle in `config-service` at `/flags/auth_fallback` but needs a safe rollout.

Matt (oncall): I'm taking this. starting triage. @Sam_K please share the minimal toggle command.

Sam_K: command:```bash
# enable fallback for all regions
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://control-plane.internal/flags/auth_fallback -d '{"enabled":true,"reason":"incident-1839001234"}'
```

Maria: also recommend increasing auth-proxy replicas by +2 and put a short TTL on org-lookup cache hits to reduce DB fanout.

Matt (oncall): executing fallback now (will post status).

pagerduty: Matt acknowledged the incident. Estimated response window 15m.

Matt (oncall): toggled auth_fallback -> true. Patch applied; restarting auth-proxy rolling deploy.

Jordan: rolling deploy logs:```text
auth-proxy-1: restart ok
auth-proxy-2: restart ok
auth-proxy-3: restart ok
```

Maria: checking metrics — 5xx rate dropped ~40% in 2m after fallback. org-lookup error rate still elevated but less traffic now.

Sam_K: I pushed a temporary config to config-service to route org-lookup to read-replica:```json
{"org_lookup":"read_replica","replica_ttl":30}
```

Elaine: CS update: Customer-impacting errors reduced per support tickets. Customers on dedicated resumed requests. Holding to watch.

Jordan: still seeing occasional gateway 502s from billing-fanout when billing service does parallel checks. Suggest pausing non-critical billing calls.

Matt (oncall): pausing billing-fanout for auth-check path: toggled `billing_parallel_checks=false`.

Maria: logs after changes: snippets show fewer timeouts:```text
[09:21:11] auth-proxy request id=abc123 status=200 ttl_cache=hit
[09:21:13] config-gateway id=def456 status=200 route=hosted-api
```

Sam_K: running a quick canary curl against control-plane:```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer test" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/models | head -n 5
```

Jordan: canary response 200. Noted 5xx count still has spikes but trending down.

Matt (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stabilize for 30m then hand to night oncall. Need runbook items: rollback toggle, verify replica TTL reset, follow-up root cause (orgs-db load). @Maria please own follow-up RCA if you can.

Maria: I can own RCA. Initial hypothesis: sudden billing/account ingestion caused high fanout to orgs-db, causing cascading timeouts and elevated 5xx. Will pull query plans and DB metrics.

Customer Success - Amy: I'll update customers with a note: partial outage earlier, mitigation applied, engineering investigating root cause.

Jordan: adding short-term monitoring alerts: org-lookup errors > 5% for 5m -> paging to eng-sre; also increased sampling on failing requests for traces.

Sam_K: also queued a mitigative change to add a circuit-breaker around billing fanout in control-plane routing. PR opened: `fix/billing-cb-183900` (will merge after post-incident review).

Matt (oncall): setting incident status -> "mitigated" for now. Will continue to watch. If errors creep back, re-escalate.

incident-bot: Incident 1839001234 status changed: MITIGATED by Matt (oncall).

Elaine: thanks everyone. Notes for follow-up: schedule RCA meeting, confirm DB scaling plan or query fixes, add a canary for auth->org lookup fanout.

Jordan: recording timeline for postmortem. I'll attach logs and metrics snapshot.

Matt (oncall): handing to night team at 10:05 UTC. Final status: fallback enabled, billing fanout paused, org-lookup routed to read replica, 5xx rates reduced to baseline.

Customer Success - Amy: customers updated. No new tickets in last 20m.

Sam_K: leaving a CLI snippet for rollback:```bash
# disable fallback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://control-plane.internal/flags/auth_fallback -d '{"enabled":false}'
# re-enable billing checks
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://control-plane.internal/flags/billing_parallel_checks -d '{"enabled":true}'
```

Matt (oncall): end of thread. Will file postmortem and assign RCA owners.
